note: Gates the game checks before it offers a quest that Tsukimichi cannot read: a relic weapon at some stage equipped, Eureka story and elemental level, Doman Enclave reconstruction progress. The quest lists the gate as not checked, so it reads Not checked where it would otherwise read Ready (never Blocked by the gate itself). "after" names the quests before which the gate cannot be passed at all; the catalog adds them to the quest's prerequisites, with "afterTextKey" the text row of an after quest that says what it opens. "gameTextKey" is the gated quest's own text row stating the gate, when the game states one. The text is never committed. Keys are Quest sheet row ids, sorted ascending.

65897.note: His Dark Materia, level 50, Zodiac Weapons: Gerolt gives it only to a character wearing a relic weapon at the nexus stage (its own text says so and its script checks it), and a nexus can only be made once Mmmmmm, Soulglazed Relics (65742) opens soulglazing. The sheet gives the quest no previous quest, so it read Ready for a character who had not started the Zodiac line (reported in game, 1.9.0). In the usual order it follows Wherefore Art Thou, Zodiac and its four material quests; only the nexus is checked by the game's script.
